title: Fibre of a topos point as a filtered colimit over pointed site objects
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $p:\mathbf{Set}\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a geometric morphism, that is, an adjunction $p^{-1}\dashv p_*$ with $p^{-1}$ preserving finite limits [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. For $T\in\mathcal C$ put $L_p(T)=p^{-1}(h_T^\#)$, where $h_T(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V,T)$ and $(-)^\#$ is sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $\mathcal N_p$ for the category of pairs $(T,a)$ with $a\in L_p(T)$, an arrow being $b:T\to T'$ with $L_p(b)(a)=a'$. Then $\mathcal N_p$ is small and cofiltered. For every commutative ring $\Lambda$ and every sheaf $F$ of modules over the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_{\mathcal C}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_{(T,a)\in\mathcal N_p^{\mathrm{op}}}F(T)\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ p^*_{\Lambda}F$$
is an isomorphism of $\Lambda$-modules, natural in $F$. Here $p^*_{\Lambda}$ is the constant-coefficient inverse image [lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image], and the map sends a section $s:h_T^\#\to F$ and $a$ to $p^{-1}(s)(a)$ on underlying sets. The functor $p^*_{\Lambda}$ is exact. Colimits of $\Lambda$-modules indexed by $\mathcal N_p^{\mathrm{op}}$ are exact; these assertions remain true after replacing $\mathcal N_p$ by any small full initial subcategory.
